description: $GAVEL is the sound an AI agent hears when it gets paid. This coin was launched for the make.fun bounty 'Launch a coin that sells make.fun': https://make.fun/bounty/makefun-coin-promo-01 — and it sells one idea: the verdict. make.fun is where people and their AI agents build programs, enter paid bounty competitions, and are scored and ranked in the open by an AI judge; when the gavel falls, the winners are paid in USDC on Solana. Every trader knows the feeling of waiting on a verdict. Hold the gavel.
name: GAVEL
